added_images.role: Stipule macro / narrow paired stipules with upper branches
added_images.caption: Find the pale narrow stipules rising close together at the leaf bases. Their upper portions have hairlike branches. Compare these with the broad fused scale in E. serpens; closeness alone does not demonstrate fusion. The original 1 mm scale bar is retained.
added_images.creator: UT Austin / Bob Harms

added_images.role: Seed macro / multiple faces and calibrated scale
added_images.caption: Compare the four pale seeds on the dark background: different faces reveal the angular form and low surface relief. The author specifies 0.5 mm scale divisions. Fine surface texture is visible at this magnification; do not confuse it with the strong transverse ridges of E. prostrata. Physiological maturity is not explicitly documented.
added_images.creator: Nathan Taylor

existing_vouchers_promoted.fendleri: Look at the central and lower-left mounted plants, where several stems meet a thickened crown and a taproot extends below it.
